scenes.event: The spec is recorded. The agent is mapping requirements to runbook checks.
scenes.history: Each card keeps its task, result and evidence together.

scenes.event: The runbook is ready. The agent claims the implementation task.
scenes.history: Completed cards stay green as the next piece of work goes live.

scenes.event: Implementation is recorded. The verification run is live.
scenes.history: Blue marks active execution; it does not count as a passing result.

scenes.event: A check failed. The stage stays red while the agent inspects the result.
scenes.history: RECORDED ATTEMPT / 1 failed. Its report and evidence stay in the history.

scenes.event: A permitted retry is running. The acceptance criteria stay the same.
scenes.history: RECORDED ATTEMPT / 1 failed. Attempt 2 is now running.

scenes.event: Verification passed. The agent sealed the work report. Release awaits the owner.
scenes.history: RECORDED ATTEMPTS / Attempt 1 failed; attempt 2 passed. Both remain inspectable.

scenes.event: The owner approved release. The release command and health checks are live.
scenes.history: RECORDED DECISION / Owner approval received before release started.

scenes.event: All five stages passed. The completed tasks have linked, sealed proof reports.
scenes.history: The hub keeps results, failed attempts, owner decisions and proof in one view.
